feature: A recording opens on a sharp first frame
summary: A recording now opens sharp at 0:00. Before, the first picture was a small thumbnail stretched up, and it stayed blurred until you moved the playhead.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open a full-screen screen recording from the Finder.
Without touching anything, look at small text in the first frame. It should be as crisp as it is a few seconds in.
Start the Cut a recording down guide from the Tutorials window.
At 0:00, look at the Ready card and the 0 under it. Compare with the blurred one from before: 2026-09-25-video-guides-cut-sc.png.
Press Command-plus to zoom in, and check the frame sharpens again a moment later.

evaluate: Does the first frame of your own recordings look sharp the moment the window opens?
Is there a visible soft-to-sharp flash as the window opens, and if so, does it bother you?
Does zooming in still sharpen the picture after a short moment?
rough: For a split second as the window opens you may still see the small read before the full-size one lands. By the time the walk has finished opening the file, the full-size frame is already in.
Nothing here changes a mock surface, so there is no side-by-side with a mock page. The change is how big the first frame is read, not what is drawn.
